resources.string: Share video address with TAK recipients
RTSP address for other TAK devices

Share an existing camera or relay address alongside fresh aircraft GPS. This sends a link; it does not upload video or start a camera. Every recipient can read the complete address, including query parameters. Use a reachable address without passwords or access tokens. Authentication should be configured separately on each viewer.
Stop the bridge before saving video settings.
Saved. The next live bridge session will share the link with fresh aircraft positions. The software demo previews it locally.
Sharing disabled and saved address cleared. The next fresh position update requests removal of the previous link in ATAK.
Socket writes confirm only local transmission. Verify the marker and video on a receiving ATAK device; receipt and playback are not acknowledged by this bridge.
